channel.title: KPFK - La Raza Radio
channel.description: Explore the rich tapestry of Chicano history, culture, and internationalism with La Raza Radio. Hosted by Matt Sedillo, Dr. Vanessa Bustamante, and Ernesto Ayala, this compelling weekly public affairs program delivers sharp political commentary and working-class narratives from a progressive, grassroots perspective. Tune in for powerful interviews with community organizers, authors, and activists dedicated to social justice and labor rights across Southern California and beyond.
